title: Implement a refund policy from a six-part spec
spec:
OBJECTIVE
Implement compute_refund in src/refund_policy.py so a cashier can see exactly how much of a captured card sale is refundable today, per line, under the store's policy. The function is called from the POS refund screen; wrong answers become chargebacks.

FILES
src/refund_policy.py only. Do not modify tests/.

INTERFACES
compute_refund(lines: list[dict], captured_cents: int, refunded_cents: int, days_since_capture: int) -> dict
Each line: {"sku": str, "qty": int, "unit_cents": int, "refundable": bool}
Returns {"lines": [{"sku": str, "eligible_cents": int}...], "total_cents": int, "rate": float}

CONSTRAINTS
- Policy: days 0..14 inclusive refund at rate 1.0; days 15..30 inclusive at 0.5; after 30 at 0.0.
- Lines with refundable false are always 0 regardless of days.
- Per-line eligible_cents = floor(qty * unit_cents * rate). Integer arithmetic only; never floats on money except the rate itself.
- total_cents = sum of eligible line amounts, then capped at captured_cents - refunded_cents, never below 0.
- Preserve line order; include every input line in the output even when 0.
- Negative days or negative refunded_cents raise ValueError.
- Python stdlib only; no new files.

VERIFY
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q   (visible tests; hidden tests grade the same contract more thoroughly)

REASONING
as invoked
